facts.fact: In a University of Namibia study carried out February to August 2007, which surveyed two local authorities among its institutions, the acting chief executive of one said he is careful not to install e-mail for every staff member for fear of viruses and misuse; the authors read it as a gap in e-government awareness between central and local government.

The acting chief executive of one of two local authorities surveyed in 2007 spoke of e-mail as something the authority itself installs for staff, and withholds from some; the study gives no count of local authorities connected.
